generalInfo.generalRule: Please be assured that public safety continues to be our priority. We have a number of security measures in place visible and non-visible, with personnel internal and external for all events. Our event and security teams continue to remain vigilant and are working together with local and national authorities to ensure our visitors have the safest and most enjoyable experience whilst visiting the Utilita Arena. We encourage you to only bring essential items and stress NO LARGE BAGS OR BACK PACKS at all will be permitted into the venue. • No Large Bags or Backpacks. Please be aware that we will not allow any large bags, backpacks, holdalls, luggage or computer bags into the venue. There is no storage or cloak room facility available so please make alternative arrangements before arriving to the venue. For full list of none permitted items please visit www.utilitaarena.co.uk/venue-information/venue-safety/ No cameras or recording devices allowed. No food or drink to be taken into the arena (unless in exceptional circumstances i.e. medical purposes). The venue is non-smoking throughout
generalInfo.childRule: Please note: As a responsible entertainment venue, the safety and comfort of our patrons is paramount. This Duty of Care is particularly relevant when protecting minors under 14 years old; as such our policy is that all children under 14 years old must be accompanied by an adult, defined as someone 18+ years of age who will be present for the full duration of the event. Because of safety regulations, anyone entering the Arena must have a paid ticket even if the child is not using the seat. (Unless otherwise stipulated by the Venue) Under 14s must be accompanied by an Adult. It is advised that children under the ages of 3yrs should not be admitted except for particular productions as advised by the Box Office Baby changing facilities are available For certain shows where the audience is both seated and standing, no one under 14 years old will be permitted AT ALL to stand on the auditorium floor. Parents should always be aware of their general responsibilities regarding their childrens safety in situations where they are outside their direct control, and indeed legislation detailing these responsibilities. Unless photographic proof of age is supplied, Arena staff will make a judgement based on visual appearance prior to entry.

events.name: Embrace
events.description:
SJM Concerts Present 
Embrace 
Plus The Rolling People and The Bunny Suit
 
Embrace's debut album, The Good Will Out, was released in 1998 and quickly became one of the biggest-selling debut albums by a British artist. With an ever-growing fanbase, festival headline slots, and large sell-out shows, Embrace wasted no time in establishing themselves as one of the country’s most exciting new bands. Numerous hit singles followed, along with albums Drawn From Memory (2000) and If You’ve Never Been (2001), before the band  unexpectedly parted company with their label, Hut Recordings in 2002.Rather than slowing them down, this only strengthened the band’s resolve. In 2004 Embrace signed to Independiente and returned with their biggest selling album to date Out Of Nothing. Bigger anthems and sold-out tours followed culminating in the release of their third number one album This New Day, in 2006. Cementing the bands reputation as one of the UK’s most iconic and influential bands of their generation.With no signs of slowing down, a hugely loyal fan base, and looking to score their ninth top ten album in succession, Embrace head into 2026 rightfully celebrating thirty years of an extraordinary journey and a well-deserved place in the history of British music.

events.description:
NX LOVES 
Friday 13th Nov 2026
EAST END DUBS 
(3 hour set)

Kitty Hall 
WILDISH

Last Entry: 11:15pm

One of last year's NX Love’s quickest sell out shows returns! 
East End Dubs is a leading figure in contemporary underground house music, known for shaping a distinct London sound that fuses stripped back groove, subtle acid influences and UKG inspired swing with deep, rolling basslines and precise, hypnotic drum work. His productions capture the essence of warehouse culture while pushing it forward for a new generation of clubbers.
Founder of the influential Eastenderz label and events brand, East End Dubs has built a globally respected platform that champions both emerging talent and established underground names. Over more than a decade of consistent output, Eastenderz has become one of the most trusted imprints in modern house music, synonymous with high quality, no frills club records and a strong community led ethos.
That vision has expanded internationally through sold out showcases in cities including Berlin, Barcelona and Paris, with appearances at iconic venues such as fabric London, Watergate Berlin, E1 London and Input Barcelona. Summers in Ibiza have seen Eastenderz take over spaces including Amnesia, Cova Santa, and regular appearances across DC10 and Pacha, cementing its reputation as a true global underground force.
More recently, East End Dubs has evolved the project further with his “ExtENDed” concept; a focus on longer, uninterrupted DJ sets that prioritise musical journey and connection between artist and crowd. Taking this format to key cities across Europe and beyond, it reinforces his reputation as an artist committed to the deeper culture of DJing.
At NX Newcastle, East End Dubs brings that signature sound and ethos to the dancefloor, joined by Kitty Hall and more still to be announced.

events.name: Interplanetary Criminal
events.description:
NX LOVES PRESENTS 

ATW
Interplanetary Criminal

(A-Z)
La La
Lauren Lo sung
Maya
Milion
+ More TBA

Last Entry: 11pm


Interplanetary Criminal returns to NX this November! One of the most exciting names in the new wave of UK garage, the Manchester based DJ and producer has built a reputation for high energy sets, heavyweight productions and a sound that pays homage to the roots of UK rave culture while pushing it firmly into the present. From underground beginnings to UK No. 1 success, Interplanetary Criminal has become a driving force in the current garage revival.
His breakthrough came with "B.O.T.A. (Baddest of Them All)", his huge 2022 collaboration with Eliza Rose, which shot to No. 1 in the UK and took his unmistakable garage sound to a global audience. But away from the charts, he's remained deeply connected to the underground, with releases and his ATW Records imprint helping shape the sound of a new generation.
Expect rolling basslines, chopped up vocals and plenty of rave energy as Interplanetary Criminal brings his signature sound back to NX.

events.description:
DAY FEVER HAS TAKEN OVER THE COUNTRY!

The day-time clubbing event started by Vicky McClure, Jonny Owen and Reverend & The Makers has swept the UK since it’s launch in 2024
‘The day-time disco that doesn’t ruin your Sunday’ has amassed a huge following with thousands of punters packing out clubs and theatres every weekend to dance the day away from. A whole generation who perhaps thought their clubbing days were behind them are blazing a trail for a new way to enjoy themselves.
Day Fever prides itself on creating a safe-space where people can just be themselves. No dress code, no egos, just enjoyment and positivity. This has seen a loyal fanbase leading to sold out shows in some of the countries most famous venues.

The music policy is simple, the greatest hits of the 20th century. Why can’t Madonna sit next to Madness? Pulp go back to back with Prince? The Stone Roses and The Rolling Stones?
90’s dance classics versus a spot of Motown? Why choose when you can enjoy it all?
Vicky McClure says ‘Travelling up and down the country and seeing so many people enjoying themselves has been such a joy, we’re just so happy that people feel comfortable at Day Fever and meeting and hearing everyone’s stories has made us realise how important it is for us all to take some time out of life and just have a bloody good dance!’
Follow DAY FEVER on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X - @DAYFEVERUK
